components.name: Spreadsheet
components.description: A Data Grid whose cells take formulas: type `=SUM(B2:B9)` or `=B2 * $C$1` and the cell shows the result, recalculated as other cells change. Cells are named by position (A1, B2…), dragging the fill handle moves relative references, and the value bar shows the formula behind the active cell. Everything else (undo, copy and paste, sort, adapters) is the Data Grid.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every local change with the data after it. Pair with `value` to control the grid.

props.name: onChanges
props.description: Change batches for syncing: user edits, undo, and redo. Remote changes are not echoed.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: The selected range, whenever it changes (rows and columns selections span the grid).

props.name: adapter
props.description: Load, save, and live-update hooks for a backend. Keep the object stable (module scope or useMemo).

props.name: cellTypes
props.description: Extra or replacement cell types, keyed by `column.type`.

props.name: headerMode
props.description: What column headers show: letters, labels, or both.

props.name: rowHeaderMode
props.description: What row headers show: numbers, labels, or both.

props.name: showColumnHeaders
props.description: Shows the column header strip (letters or labels) above the cells. Defaults to true.

props.name: showRowHeaders
props.description: Shows the row header strip (numbers or labels) left of the cells. Defaults to true.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling area.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Locks the whole grid. Lock a row or column with its own `readOnly`.

props.name: cellReadOnly
props.description: Locks single cells: return true and the cell won't edit, toggle, or take pasted, filled, or cleared values. Runs on top of row and column `readOnly`.

props.name: showNameBox
props.description: Shows the Name Box and value bar above the grid.

props.name: autoFitButton
props.description: Shows a round button at the top right of the Name Box bar that sizes columns to their content: the selected columns, or all of them.

props.name: confirmDelete
props.description: Asks before deleting rows or columns that hold data. Empty ones are deleted right away. Defaults to true.

props.name: maxFitWidth
props.description: Widest a column gets from auto-fit.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra controls at the right of the Name Box bar.

props.name: footer
props.description: A status bar under the grid, such as a selection summary. The bar under the grid that holds sheet tabs and the selection summary. Pass content to show it at the start of the bar, or `false` to hide the bar.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Clicking a column header sorts by it (A → Z, then Z → A). Columns can override with `sortable`.

props.name: sortIndicator
props.description: How a sorted header shows its direction: `arrow` beside the label, or `chevron` in the header's top (ascending) or bottom (descending) gutter. Unsorted headers show nothing either way.

props.name: formatRules
props.description: Conditional formatting from your app, applied after `data.rules`. Plain JSON: load it from a backend and pass it straight through.

props.name: filterMenu
props.description: Default sections for every filter menu: `sort`, `conditions` (or a list of operators), and `values`. A column's `filterable: { ... }` overrides these.

props.name: createId
props.description: Makes ids for new rows and columns, e.g. to match database keys.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows and columns rendered beyond the viewport on each side.

props.name: variables
props.description: Named values formulas can use next to cell references, e.g. `{ taxRate: 0.08 }`.

props.name: functions
props.description: Extra functions, or replacements for built-ins. Names ignore case.

props.name: formatResult
props.description: Display text for formula results. Numbers default to en-US grouping.

props.name: onResults
props.description: Every formula's result, after each change.

props.name: selectionSummary
props.description: Adds up the selection in the footer once it holds two or more numbers. Pass a function to write your own text, or `false` to hide it.

props.name: sheets
props.description: Sheets shown as tabs in the footer, like workbook tabs. Each sheet is its own grid.

props.name: defaultSheets
props.description: Starting sheets when `sheets` is not controlled.

props.name: activeSheet
props.description: Id of the sheet on screen.
